# Mirza Mahrab Hossain

> AI Engineer & Software Developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Specializing in LLMs, AI Agents, Voice AI, and Cybersecurity.

## About

Mirza Mahrab Hossain is an AI Engineer currently working at Pipeline Inc (Dhaka, Bangladesh) as a Junior AI Engineer on a hybrid basis since August 2025. He holds a degree from BRAC University and has 1+ years of professional experience building intelligent systems, AI agents, and scalable software.

His technical focus areas include: Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, Voice AI, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, DevOps, and full-stack Web Development.
